'''Bilbousa Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. [[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] ''[[Red Silk Chances]]'', containing [[Shigar Konshi]] and [[Larin Moxla]] with other passengers, landed here in [[3643 BBY]].
